data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER specimen_associated_data_same_project
BEFORE INSERT ON specimenAssociatedData
BEGIN
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN (SELECT projectUuid FROM associatedData
              WHERE primaryId = NEW.associatedDataId) IS NULL
          OR (SELECT projectUuid FROM specimen
              WHERE uuid = NEW.specimenUuid) IS NULL
          OR (SELECT projectUuid FROM associatedData
              WHERE primaryId = NEW.associatedDataId)
             != (SELECT projectUuid FROM specimen
                 WHERE uuid = NEW.specimenUuid)
        THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'Associated data and specimen must share a project')
    END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER custom_field_value_validate_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON customFieldValue
WHEN NEW.isLegacy = 0
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM customFieldDefinition d
    WHERE d.id = NEW.fieldDefinitionId
      AND d.uiSection = CASE
        WHEN NEW.siteId IS NOT NULL THEN 'siteAttribute'
        WHEN NEW.specimenUuid IS NOT NULL THEN 'specimenAttribute'
        WHEN NEW.specimenPartId IS NOT NULL THEN 'specimenPart'
        WHEN NEW.parasiteId IS NOT NULL THEN 'parasite'
      END
      AND (d.scope = 'global' OR d.projectUuid = NEW.projectUuid)
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'Custom field definition does not match its value owner') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM customFieldDefinition d
    WHERE d.id = NEW.fieldDefinitionId
      AND (
        (NEW.siteId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM site s
          WHERE s.id = NEW.siteId AND s.projectUuid = NEW.projectUuid
        )) OR
        (NEW.specimenUuid IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM specimen s
          WHERE s.uuid = NEW.specimenUuid AND s.projectUuid = NEW.projectUuid
            AND (d.catalogFormat IS NULL OR d.catalogFormat = CASE lower(s.taxonGroup)
              WHEN 'birds' THEN 'birds'
              WHEN 'herpetofauna' THEN 'herpetofauna'
              WHEN 'arthropods' THEN 'arthropods'
              ELSE 'mammals' END)
        )) OR
        (NEW.specimenPartId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM specimenPart p JOIN specimen s ON s.uuid = p.specimenUuid
          WHERE p.id = NEW.specimenPartId AND s.projectUuid = NEW.projectUuid
            AND (d.catalogFormat IS NULL OR d.catalogFormat = CASE lower(s.taxonGroup)
              WHEN 'birds' THEN 'birds'
              WHEN 'herpetofauna' THEN 'herpetofauna'
              WHEN 'arthropods' THEN 'arthropods'
              ELSE 'mammals' END)
        )) OR
        (NEW.parasiteId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM parasite p JOIN specimen s ON s.uuid = p.specimenUuid
          WHERE p.id = NEW.parasiteId AND s.projectUuid = NEW.projectUuid
            AND (d.catalogFormat IS NULL OR d.catalogFormat = CASE lower(s.taxonGroup)
              WHEN 'birds' THEN 'birds'
              WHEN 'herpetofauna' THEN 'herpetofauna'
              WHEN 'arthropods' THEN 'arthropods'
              ELSE 'mammals' END)
        ))
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'Custom field value project or catalog does not match its owner') END;
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "description" TEXT, "principalInvestigator" TEXT, "accession" TEXT, "catalogNumberPrefix" TEXT, "currentCatalogNumber" INTEGER, "catalogNumberSuffix" TEXT, "location" TEXT, "timeZone" TEXT, "startDate" TEXT, "endDate" TEXT, "created" TEXT, "lastAccessed" TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personnel" ("uuid" TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT, "initial" TEXT, "email" TEXT, "phone" TEXT, "affiliation" TEXT, "orcid" TEXT, "role" TEXT, "currentFieldNumber" INTEGER, "notes" TEXT, "photoPath" TEXT, "isRegisterField" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media" ("primaryId" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "projectUuid" TEXT, "secondaryId" TEXT, "category" TEXT, "tag" TEXT, "taken" TEXT, "camera" TEXT, "lenses" TEXT, "additionalExif" TEXT, "personnelId" TEXT, "fileName" TEXT, "uri" TEXT, "caption" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(personnelId)REFERENCES personnel(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(projectUuid)REFERENCES project(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "site" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "siteID" TEXT, "projectUuid" TEXT, "leadStaffId" TEXT, "siteType" TEXT, "country" TEXT, "stateProvince" TEXT, "county" TEXT, "municipality" TEXT, "mediaID" TEXT, "locality" TEXT, "remark" TEXT, "habitatType" TEXT, "habitatCondition" TEXT, "habitatDescription" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(mediaID)REFERENCES media(primaryId), FOREIGN KEY(leadStaffId)REFERENCES personnel(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fossilSite" ("siteID" INTEGER, "formation" TEXT, "geologicEra" INTEGER, "geologicPeriod" INTEGER, "geologicSeries" INTEGER, "geologicEpoch" INTEGER, "narrowerGeologicStage" TEXT, "broaderGeologicStage" TEXT, "biozone" TEXT, "rockType" TEXT, "depositionalEnvironmentType" INTEGER, "depositionalContinent" TEXT, "depositionalMarine" TEXT, "standardPreservationType" TEXT, "stratigraphyRemark" TEXT, "stratigraphicSource" TEXT, "sedimentologyRemark" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(siteID)REFERENCES site(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coordinate" ("id" INTEGER UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "nameId" TEXT, "decimalLatitude" REAL, "decimalLongitude" REAL, "verbatimLatitude" TEXT, "verbatimLongitude" TEXT, "verbatimCoordinates" TEXT, "verbatimCoordinateSystem" TEXT, "elevationInMeter" REAL, "datum" TEXT, "uncertaintyInMeters" INTEGER, "gpsUnit" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "siteID" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(siteID)REFERENCES site(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collEvent" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "idSuffix" TEXT, "projectUuid" TEXT, "startDate" TEXT, "startTime" TEXT, "endDate" TEXT, "endTime" TEXT, "primaryCollMethod" TEXT, "collMethodNotes" TEXT, "siteID" INTEGER REFERENCES site(id), FOREIGN KEY(projectUuid)REFERENCES project(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weather" ("eventID" INTEGER, "lowestDayTempC" REAL, "highestDayTempC" REAL, "lowestNightTempC" REAL, "highestNightTempC" REAL, "averageHumidity" REAL, "dewPointTemp" REAL, "sunriseTime" TEXT, "sunsetTime" TEXT, "moonPhase" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(eventID)REFERENCES collEvent(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collPersonnel" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "eventID" INTEGER, "personnelId" TEXT, "name" TEXT, "role" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(eventID)REFERENCES collEvent(id), FOREIGN KEY(personnelId)REFERENCES personnel(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collEffort" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "eventID" INTEGER, "method" TEXT, "brand" TEXT, "count" INTEGER, "size" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(eventID)REFERENCES collEvent(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "narrative" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "projectUuid" TEXT, "date" TEXT, "time" TEXT, "siteID" INTEGER, "writerId" TEXT, "narrative" TEXT, "mediaID" INTEGER REFERENCES media(primaryId), FOREIGN KEY(projectUuid)REFERENCES project(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(siteID)REFERENCES site(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "narrativeMedia" ("narrativeId" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mediaId" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(narrativeId)REFERENCES narrative(id), FOREIGN KEY(mediaId)REFERENCES media(primaryId));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "siteMedia" ("siteId" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mediaId" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(siteId)REFERENCES site(id), FOREIGN KEY(mediaId)REFERENCES media(primaryId));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "eventMedia" ("eventID" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mediaId" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(eventID)REFERENCES collEvent(id), FOREIGN KEY(mediaId)REFERENCES media(primaryId));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "taxonomy" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "taxonRank" TEXT, "kingdom" TEXT, "phylum" TEXT, "taxonClass" TEXT, "taxonOrder" TEXT, "taxonFamily" TEXT, "genus" TEXT, "specificEpithet" TEXT, "subspecificEpithet" TEXT, "authors" TEXT, "commonName" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "citesStatus" TEXT, "redListCategory" TEXT, "countryStatus" TEXT, "sortingOrder" INTEGER, "mediaId" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(mediaId)REFERENCES media(primaryId));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "specimen" ("uuid" TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "projectUuid" TEXT, "speciesID" INTEGER, "iDConfidence" INTEGER, "iDMethod" TEXT, "taxonGroup" TEXT, "condition" TEXT, "prepDate" TEXT, "prepTime" TEXT, "collectionDate" TEXT, "collectionTime" TEXT, "captureDate" TEXT, "isRelativeTime" INTEGER, "captureTime" TEXT, "relativeCaptureTime" TEXT, "trapType" TEXT, "methodID" TEXT, "coordinateID" INTEGER, "coordinateExtentMeters" REAL, "catalogerID" TEXT, "fieldNumber" INTEGER, "projectFieldNumber" INTEGER, "collEventID" INTEGER, "isMultipleCollector" INTEGER, "collPersonnelID" INTEGER, "collMethodID" INTEGER, "museumID" TEXT, "determinerID" TEXT REFERENCES personnel(uuid), "preparatorID" TEXT REFERENCES personnel(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(projectUuid)REFERENCES project(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(catalogerID)REFERENCES personnel(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(collPersonnelID)REFERENCES collPersonnel(id), FOREIGN KEY(collMethodID)REFERENCES collEffort(id), FOREIGN KEY(speciesID)REFERENCES taxonomy(id), FOREIGN KEY(collEventID)REFERENCES collEvent(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "specimenMedia" ("specimenUuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "mediaId" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(mediaId)REFERENCES media(primaryId));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "associatedData" ("primaryId" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "projectUuid" TEXT REFERENCES project(uuid)ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT, "type" TEXT, "date" TEXT, "description" TEXT, "uri" TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "specimenAssociatedData" ("specimenUuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "associatedDataId" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(specimenUuid, associatedDataId), FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(associatedDataId)REFERENCES associatedData(primaryId)ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "siteAssociatedData" ("siteId" INTEGER NOT NULL, "associatedDataId" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(siteId, associatedDataId), FOREIGN KEY(siteId)REFERENCES site(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(associatedDataId)REFERENCES associatedData(primaryId)ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "eventAssociatedData" ("eventID" INTEGER NOT NULL, "associatedDataId" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(eventID, associatedDataId), FOREIGN KEY(eventID)REFERENCES collEvent(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(associatedDataId)REFERENCES associatedData(primaryId)ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TRIGGER specimen_associated_data_same_project BEFORE INSERT ON specimenAssociatedData BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT projectUuid FROM associatedData WHERE primaryId = NEW.associatedDataId) IS NULL OR (SELECT projectUuid FROM specimen WHERE uuid = NEW.specimenUuid) IS NULL OR (SELECT projectUuid FROM associatedData WHERE primaryId = NEW.associatedDataId) != (SELECT projectUuid FROM specimen WHERE uuid = NEW.specimenUuid) THEN RAISE (ABORT, 'Associated data and specimen must share a project') END;END

CREATE TRIGGER site_associated_data_same_project BEFORE INSERT ON siteAssociatedData BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT projectUuid FROM associatedData WHERE primaryId = NEW.associatedDataId) IS NULL OR (SELECT projectUuid FROM site WHERE id = NEW.siteId) IS NULL OR (SELECT projectUuid FROM associatedData WHERE primaryId = NEW.associatedDataId) != (SELECT projectUuid FROM site WHERE id = NEW.siteId) THEN RAISE (ABORT, 'Associated data and site must share a project') END;END

CREATE TRIGGER event_associated_data_same_project BEFORE INSERT ON eventAssociatedData BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT projectUuid FROM associatedData WHERE primaryId = NEW.associatedDataId) IS NULL OR (SELECT projectUuid FROM collEvent WHERE id = NEW.eventID) IS NULL OR (SELECT projectUuid FROM associatedData WHERE primaryId = NEW.associatedDataId) != (SELECT projectUuid FROM collEvent WHERE id = NEW.eventID) THEN RAISE (ABORT, 'Associated data and event must share a project') END;END
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personnelList" ("projectUuid" TEXT, "personnelUuid" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(projectUuid)REFERENCES project(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(personnelUuid)REFERENCES personnel(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mammalAttribute" ("specimenUuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "showBatFields" INTEGER, "totalLength" REAL, "tailLength" REAL, "hindFootLength" REAL, "earLength" REAL, "forearm" REAL, "tibia" REAL, "showEchoFields" INTEGER, "echolocation" INTEGER, "frequencyMax" REAL, "frequencyMin" REAL, "frequencyAtMaxEnergy" REAL, "duration" REAL, "weight" REAL, "weightUnit" TEXT, "accuracy" TEXT, "accuracySpecify" TEXT, "sex" INTEGER, "age" INTEGER, "testisPosition" INTEGER, "testisLength" REAL, "testisWidth" REAL, "epididymisAppearance" INTEGER, "reproductiveStage" INTEGER, "leftPlacentalScars" INTEGER, "rightPlacentalScars" INTEGER, "mammaeCondition" INTEGER, "mammaeInguinalCount" INTEGER, "mammaeAxillaryCount" INTEGER, "mammaeAbdominalCount" INTEGER, "vaginaOpening" INTEGER, "pubicSymphysis" INTEGER, "embryoLeftCount" INTEGER, "embryoRightCount" INTEGER, "embryoCR" INTEGER, "remark" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "birdAttribute" ("specimenUuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight" REAL, "weightUnit" TEXT, "wingspan" REAL, "irisColor" TEXT, "irisHex" TEXT, "billColor" TEXT, "billHex" TEXT, "maxillaColor" TEXT, "maxillaHex" TEXT, "mandibleColor" TEXT, "mandibleHex" TEXT, "toeColor" TEXT, "toeHex" TEXT, "tarsusColor" TEXT, "tarsusHex" TEXT, "sex" INTEGER, "broodPatch" INTEGER, "skullOssification" INTEGER, "hasBursa" INTEGER, "bursaWidth" REAL, "bursaLength" REAL, "fat" INTEGER, "stomachContent" TEXT, "testisLength" REAL, "testisWidth" REAL, "testisRemark" TEXT, "ovaryLength" REAL, "ovaryWidth" REAL, "oviductWidth" REAL, "ovaryAppearance" INTEGER, "firstOvaSize" REAL, "secondOvaSize" REAL, "thirdOvaSize" REAL, "oviductAppearance" INTEGER, "ovaryRemark" TEXT, "wingIsMolt" INTEGER, "wingMolt" TEXT, "tailIsMolt" INTEGER, "tailMolt" TEXT, "bodyMolt" INTEGER, "moltRemark" TEXT, "specimenRemark" TEXT, "habitatRemark" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "herpAttribute" ("specimenUuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "sex" INTEGER, "age" INTEGER, "weight" REAL, "weightUnit" TEXT, "svl" REAL, "remark" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "arthropodAttribute" ("specimenUuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "headWidth" REAL, "bodyLength" REAL, "wingspanUpper" REAL, "wingspanLower" REAL, "sex" INTEGER, "hostOrganism" TEXT, "hostPart" TEXT, "canopyAffinity" TEXT, "canopyCover" TEXT, "ambientTemperature" REAL, "ambientHumidity" REAL, "waterTemperature" REAL, "pH" REAL, "dissolvedOxygen" REAL, "flowVelocity" REAL, "remark" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "specimenPart" ("id" INTEGER UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "specimenUuid" TEXT, "personnelId" TEXT, "tissueID" TEXT, "barcodeID" TEXT, "type" TEXT, "count" TEXT, "treatment" TEXT, "additionalTreatment" TEXT, "storage" TEXT, "storageLocation" TEXT, "dateTaken" TEXT, "timeTaken" TEXT, "pmi" TEXT, "museumPermanent" TEXT, "museumLoan" TEXT, "remark" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid), FOREIGN KEY(personnelId)REFERENCES personnel(uuid));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customFieldDefinition" ("id" INTEGER UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "sourceTemplateUuid" TEXT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "uiSection" TEXT NOT NULL, "options" TEXT, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "projectUuid" TEXT, "catalogFormat" TEXT, "sortOrder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "isArchived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (isArchived IN (0, 1)), "dwcTarget" TEXT, "dwcField" TEXT, "dwcMode" TEXT, "allowDwcConflict" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (allowDwcConflict IN (0, 1)), "createdAt" TEXT, "updatedAt" TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(projectUuid)REFERENCES project(uuid)ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK((scope = 'global' AND projectUuid IS NULL)OR(scope = 'project' AND projectUuid IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(uiSection != 'siteAttribute' OR catalogFormat IS NULL), CHECK((dwcTarget IS NULL AND dwcField IS NULL AND dwcMode IS NULL)OR(dwcTarget IS NOT NULL AND dwcField IS NOT NULL AND dwcMode IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customFieldValue" ("id" INTEGER UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "fieldDefinitionId" INTEGER NOT NULL, "projectUuid" TEXT, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT, "siteId" INTEGER, "specimenUuid" TEXT, "specimenPartId" INTEGER, "parasiteId" INTEGER, "isLegacy" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (isLegacy IN (0, 1)), FOREIGN KEY(fieldDefinitionId)REFERENCES customFieldDefinition(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(projectUuid)REFERENCES project(uuid)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(siteId)REFERENCES site(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(specimenUuid)REFERENCES specimen(uuid)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(specimenPartId)REFERENCES specimenPart(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(parasiteId)REFERENCES parasite(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, CHECK((isLegacy = 1 AND siteId IS NULL AND specimenUuid IS NULL AND specimenPartId IS NULL AND parasiteId IS NULL)OR(isLegacy = 0 AND projectUuid IS NOT NULL AND((siteId IS NOT NULL)+(specimenUuid IS NOT NULL)+(specimenPartId IS NOT NULL)+(parasiteId IS NOT NULL))= 1)));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS custom_field_site_value_idx ON customFieldValue (fieldDefinitionId, siteId) WHERE siteId IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS custom_field_specimen_value_idx ON customFieldValue (fieldDefinitionId, specimenUuid) WHERE specimenUuid IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS custom_field_part_value_idx ON customFieldValue (fieldDefinitionId, specimenPartId) WHERE specimenPartId IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS custom_field_parasite_value_idx ON customFieldValue (fieldDefinitionId, parasiteId) WHERE parasiteId IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS custom_field_template_target_idx ON customFieldDefinition (sourceTemplateUuid, scope, ifnull(projectUuid, '')) WHERE sourceTemplateUuid IS NOT NULL

CREATE TRIGGER custom_field_value_validate_insert BEFORE INSERT ON customFieldValue WHEN NEW.isLegacy = 0 BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customFieldDefinition AS d WHERE d.id = NEW.fieldDefinitionId AND d.uiSection = CASE WHEN NEW.siteId IS NOT NULL THEN 'siteAttribute' WHEN NEW.specimenUuid IS NOT NULL THEN 'specimenAttribute' WHEN NEW.specimenPartId IS NOT NULL THEN 'specimenPart' WHEN NEW.parasiteId IS NOT NULL THEN 'parasite' END AND(d.scope = 'global' OR d.projectUuid = NEW.projectUuid)) THEN RAISE (ABORT, 'Custom field definition does not match its value owner') END;SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customFieldDefinition AS d WHERE d.id = NEW.fieldDefinitionId AND((NEW.siteId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM site AS s WHERE s.id = NEW.siteId AND s.projectUuid = NEW.projectUuid))OR(NEW.specimenUuid IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM specimen AS s WHERE s.uuid = NEW.specimenUuid AND s.projectUuid = NEW.projectUuid AND(d.catalogFormat IS NULL OR d.catalogFormat = CASE lower(s.taxonGroup) WHEN 'birds' THEN 'birds' WHEN 'herpetofauna' THEN 'herpetofauna' WHEN 'arthropods' THEN 'arthropods' ELSE 'mammals' END)))OR(NEW.specimenPartId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM specimenPart AS p JOIN specimen AS s ON s.uuid = p.specimenUuid WHERE p.id = NEW.specimenPartId AND s.projectUuid = NEW.projectUuid AND(d.catalogFormat IS NULL OR d.catalogFormat = CASE lower(s.taxonGroup) WHEN 'birds' THEN 'birds' WHEN 'herpetofauna' THEN 'herpetofauna' WHEN 'arthropods' THEN 'arthropods' ELSE 'mammals' END)))OR(NEW.parasiteId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parasite AS p JOIN specimen AS s ON s.uuid = p.specimenUuid WHERE p.id = NEW.parasiteId AND s.projectUuid = NEW.projectUuid AND(d.catalogFormat IS NULL OR d.catalogFormat = CASE lower(s.taxonGroup) WHEN 'birds' THEN 'birds' WHEN 'herpetofauna' THEN 'herpetofauna' WHEN 'arthropods' THEN 'arthropods' ELSE 'mammals' END))))) THEN RAISE (ABORT, 'Custom field value project or catalog does not match its owner') END;END
